claims.quote: Type locality: rapids above Marabá, Rio Tocantins drainage, Pará State, Brazil.
South America: Tocantins River basin, Brazil.

regions.name: Tocantins
regions.quote: Endemic to Brazil, it occurs in the Tocantins and Araguaia river basins, in the states of Goiás, Mato Grosso, Pará and Tocantins, where it is infrequent and not very abundant.
